text:
Ivy: Quick find  the API ref for POST /feature-flags shows the `enabled` param as "true"/"false" (strings) in the curl example, but the schema and SDKs use booleans. This is causing a confusing example where cURL sends a string and server rejects it in strict mode.

Tom: Oof. Which file? I can grep the examples.

Ivy: docs/openapi/paths/feature-flags.yaml. The example body currently: `{"key":"new_ui","enabled":"true"}`. Should be `{"enabled": true}`. Also header in that curl sample uses `Content-Type: text/plain` (another stray)  must be application/json.

Sam: I'll take this. Plan: update OpenAPI example values to use boolean types, fix curl/python/js snippets to send JSON boolean, and add a short note under the endpoint: "Note: use JSON booleans for `enabled`; legacy clients might send strings."

Ivy: Also update Go example: some generated snippets show `Enabled string` in example structs. Change example snippet to `Enabled bool` and add a one-liner to coerce legacy string flags in client helpers.

Sam: Good call. I'll include this Go helper in the docs PR:

```go
// normalize legacy string flag values to bool
func parseEnabled(v interface{}) bool {
    switch t := v.(type) {
    case bool: return t
    case string: return t == "true"
    default: return false
    }
}
```

Ivy: Can we also add a docs-e2e lint that fails if examples for `enabled` match `"(true|false)"`? Simple regex to catch strings.

docs-lint-bot: Created issue #2102 and draft branch docs/feature-flag-examples. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/g/infra/docs/pulls/3121 (OpenAPI example edits + SDK snippet updates + docs-e2e lint).

Tom: I'll review PR once it's up. Sam, ping when CI passes.

Sam: Will do. ETA: 4 hrs.

Ivy: Thanks  this should cut down on stray support tickets about rejected payloads.
